body: I feel my heart racing as I sit there, the note on my desk an ominous presence. The fluorescent lights above seem to hum louder, creating an unsettling ambiance. I scan the room, trying to distract myself, but my mind keeps wandering back to the words on the paper. My breathing becomes shallow, and my hands begin to tremble. I try to gather my thoughts, to think of a rational explanation for the note, but my instincts scream at me to escape. I grab my jacket and head towards the door, trying to put real distance between myself and it.
